title: Tutor configuration
description: Tutor values read as data (AR-22): the CandidateEnumerator's depth and Move set, the RecoveryPlanner's search bound, and the adaptive assistance thresholds (FR-13). Mastery thresholds arrive with their consumers.

adaptive.description: When adaptive assistance changes the help: Harmful Moves on a step before it explains, demonstrates or guides (strictly increasing), and clean steps in a row before it reduces help.
